title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
first_author_affiliation: EPFL / Swiss Data Science Center (EPFL and ETH Zurich)
affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 PDF byline cross-checked against fixed HTML; research-execution relations kept separate.
code_status: 已发布原作者源码：[https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa](https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa)；Apache-2.0；已核对修订6224a46e7e439385ce432ce3f600afb88fb1e5a2。

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: 原文从头训练135M/360M模型，分别2.7B/7.24B token，单H200每run，并包含学习率选择、长上下文续训、三seed子研究和dense对照。完整训练矩阵超出本轮单A100/A30短预算；仅小张量组件预期三seed合计小于30秒，零模型/数据下载、零API。
cost_assessment.model_scale: The paper trains135M/360M models from scratch on2.7B/7.24B tokens using one H200 per run, with tuning, long-context continuation, a three-seed substudy and dense controls. The complete campaign is outside this short single-A100/A30 budget. The tensor component is expected to take under30seconds across three seeds, with no model/data downloads or API calls.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Fixed-paper configuration, not measured full-run time; no costly probe.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅低成本HiSA公式组件验收

summary: HiSA不先筛token，而是对每个query-key点积只保留尚未超过角度预算的RoPE频率对。近处key保留更多分量，远处仅保留慢频分量；Q/K投影不变，规则只由位置、RoPE base和预算决定。 实现精确Eq3的fp32/fp64小张量参考、因果/越reach屏蔽、带绝对位置的decode对齐与梯度负控。显式物化每pair分数，不是稀疏kernel；不实现FA3 block近似、GQA存储压缩、decoder训练、真实KV allocator或吞吐优化。GPU验收另由主运行器冻结后实跑，不以CPU单测代替。
